reviews.review_text:
Jack
1 contribution

service good
Aug 2026 • Family
This is one of my family's favorite restaurants at Saigon Centre. The food is delicious and well-seasoned, and the prices are reasonable given the prime central location. While the space isn't huge, the seating layout is well-organized and clean; there are also private rooms available for families and groups of friends. Robert, a staff member there, was incredibly enthusiastic and helpful. I will definitely continue to support Dim Tu Tac and this Saigon Centre branch for a long time to come. Some of the delicious dishes I frequently order include spicy vinegar meat dumplings, shrimp and scallop dumplings, salted egg yolk buns, roasted pigeon, jellyfish salad, Sichuan hot and sour soup, Sichuan-style tofu with mushrooms, crab glass noodles, and shrimp glass noodles. As for drinks, I usually go for the Hong Kong-style milk tea—it has a rich tea flavor and is absolutely delicious.

reviews.review_text:
Nguyen C
1 contribution
0
It’s real swell, check it out!
Aug 2026 • Family
The food was great, and the service was excellent. The dim sum selection was all diversely delicious, and one of my favourites was the mushroom one with its unique fragrance. The staff were all friendly, and the service was impeccable. They were quick and meticulous in their work, affable and helpful to the customers. Ms June was particularly dedicated and made the whole experience smooth sailing with her expert advice. Highly recommend for anyone in the area. The atmosphere is fancy and charming; there are beautiful lanterns hung, and a couple of miniature birds scattered across that are fun to spot. This small yet significant attention to detail is imbued in every process. True to their value, they are constantly reinventing themselves in expanding new ideas and possibilities while staying true to the Cantonese cuisine roots permeating in every garnished dish and delicate dressing, each ingredient carefully selected for harmonious taste and sophisticated appearance. The price range is reasonable and affordable for what they offer while still healthy and fulfilling. I waited almost no time at all, making the time between ordering and the delivery a swift one, everyone being very quick yet still maintaining quality as the service is mindful of the famished. I appreciate their earnest communication, and any dish that might take a while (which they will always disclose to the guest beforehand) is well worth it. Exiting the escalator on the fifth floor of Takashimaya, you're faced with the restaurant, the choice of location being another considerate, deliberate choice. Mindful of the distance, this situates Dim Tu Tac as the place to dine upon exiting the escalator or elevator, shortening the distance and time for maximum efficiency. Being located in the mall had its great perks, as being near the entrance made everything so easy to navigate through while presenting no shortage of entertainment to occupy one's time afterwards. It's organised, well lit, sanitary and delectable. It's quite the authentic flavour and a favourite experience I love to return to.
